question: What are the most influential papers on AlphaFold protein structure prediction? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers regarding AlphaFold protein structure prediction, based on citation counts, include the seminal work on AlphaFold itself, the recent advancements in AlphaFold 3 for biomolecular interactions, and the foundational AlphaFold Protein Structure Database.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2","title":"Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold","citation_count":36810},{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w","title":"Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3","citation_count":11304},{"doi":"10.1093/nar/gkab1061","title":"AlphaFold Protein Structure Database: massively expanding the structural coverage of protein-sequence space with high-accuracy models","citation_count":6713},{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-019-1923-7","title":"Improved protein structure prediction using potentials from deep learning","citation_count":2877},{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-021-03828-1","title":"Highly accurate protein structure prediction for the human proteome","citation_count":2672}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers regarding AlphaFold protein structure prediction, based on citation counts, include the seminal work on AlphaFold itself, the recent advancements in AlphaFold 3 for biomolecular interactions, and the foundational AlphaFold Protein Structure Database.
